responsibility: Declares the built-in MIR dataflow analysis implementation submodules and re-exports their public analysis types and helper APIs as the `impls` module surface. It serves as the integration point that organizes borrowed-local, initialization, liveness, and storage-liveness analyses into one public module interface.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `framework/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` does not provide reusable solver infrastructure, and unlike `move_paths/mod.rs` it does not model MIR move trees. Its role is specifically to collect the crate’s built-in analysis implementations by declaring their submodules and re-exporting their public analysis types as the `impls` surface.
